about.en: BOSON is the token of Boson Protocol, a decentralized commerce protocol for exchanging physical and digital items through on-chain redeemable NFTs (rNFTs) with escrow and dispute resolution. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xc477d038d5420c6a9e0b031712f61c5120090de9, with bridged deployments on Polygon, Base, Arbitrum and Optimism.
